{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for the six QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}")

# Check if there are any refunded orders
refunded_orders = df[df['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {len(refunded_orders)}")

# Check the current dtype of 'revenue'
print("Current dtype of 'revenue':", df['revenue'].dtype)

# Convert revenue from string to float, removing commas
# First, check for commas in the revenue string
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Check if any revenue values are suspiciously high
high_revenue = df[df['revenue_clean'] > 10000]
print(f"Number of orders with revenue > $10,000: {len(high_revenue)}")

# Check if the six QA orders are present
qa_check = df[df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print(f"Number of QA orders found (revenue == 999999.99): {len(qa_check)}")"}
